## Function-Based Enzyme Generation

Function-Based Enzyme Generation

Exact job name: `Function_Based_Enzyme_Generation`.

### Inputs

Fields below belong in `experiment_data`; `experiment_name` is supplied separately.

| Field | Type | Required | Input kind | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | string | yes | value | EC number a.b.c.d. |
| `n_samples` | integer | yes | value | Number of sequences |
| `file_format` | string | no / mode-dependent | value | `"csv"` (default) |

Input kinds: `value` is inline data; `file` requires a platform file reference;
`file_or_value` supports either documented mode; `artifact` is an authorized upstream result reference.
Only local files require a new upload. Never infer input mode from a field name.

## Genzyme Generation

Generate candidate enzyme structures conditioned on substrate and product SMILES.

Exact job name: `Genzyme_Generation`.

### Inputs

Fields below belong in `experiment_data`; `experiment_name` is supplied separately.

| Field | Type | Required | Input kind | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `input_substrate` | string | yes | value | Substrate SMILES. |
| `input_product` | string | yes | value | Product SMILES. |
| `num_structures` | integer | yes | value | Number of enzyme structures to generate; product validation range is 1–100000 |
| `complex_generation` | string | no / mode-dependent | value | Accepted as `"True"` by the verified submission, but absent from the product-sheet schema; omit unless the user explicitly requests it |
| `top_k` | integer | no / mode-dependent | value | Accepted as `2` by the verified submission, but absent from the product-sheet schema; omit unless the user explicitly requests it |

## EnzyControl

Generate enzyme backbones from a chain, motif residue labels and substrate SMILES.

[Product description and result interpretation](../enzyme-tools-guide.md#enzycontrol)

Exact job name: `enzycontrol`.

### Inputs

Fields below belong in `experiment_data`; `experiment_name` is supplied separately.

| Field | Type | Required | Input kind | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `pdb_path` | string | yes | file | Relative storage path to one PDB file. |
| `chain_id` | string | yes | value | Exactly one case-sensitive chain character. |
| `motif_residues` | array | yes | value | Residue labels within the selected chain, e.g. 25 or 26A. |
| `smiles` | string | yes | value | Nonempty substrate SMILES; maximum 128 atoms including hydrogens. |
| `n_samples` | integer | no / mode-dependent | value | Optional; runtime defaults to 1. |
| `seed` | integer | yes | value | Required by live FastAPI even though local runtime can generate one; 0-4294967295. |

Input kinds: `value` is inline data; `file` requires a platform file reference;
`file_or_value` supports either documented mode; `artifact` is an authorized upstream result reference.
Only local files require a new upload. Never infer input mode from a field name.

### Exact request schema

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "pdb_path": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Relative storage path to one PDB file.",
      "x-input-kind": "file"
    },
    "chain_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Exactly one case-sensitive chain character.",
      "x-input-kind": "value",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 1
    },
    "motif_residues": {
      "type": "array",
      "minItems": 1,
      "uniqueItems": true,
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "pattern": "^-?[0-9]+[A-Za-z]?$"
      },
      "description": "Residue labels within the selected chain, e.g. 25 or 26A.",
      "x-input-kind": "value"
    },
    "smiles": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Nonempty substrate SMILES; maximum 128 atoms including hydrogens.",
      "x-input-kind": "value",
      "minLength": 1
    },
    "n_samples": {
      "type": "integer",
      "description": "Optional; runtime defaults to 1.",
      "x-input-kind": "value",
      "minimum": 1
    },
    "seed": {
      "type": "integer",
      "description": "Required by live FastAPI even though local runtime can generate one; 0-4294967295.",
      "x-input-kind": "value",
      "minimum": 0,
      "maximum": 4294967295
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "pdb_path",
    "chain_id",
    "motif_residues",
    "smiles",
    "seed"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false
}
```

### Submission envelope

Shape only: replace placeholders with the user's values. This is not a runnable sample.
```json
{
  "job_name": "enzycontrol",
  "experiment_name": "<confirmed experiment name>",
  "experiment_data": {
    "pdb_path": "<user value; see pdb_path schema>",
    "chain_id": "<user value; see chain_id schema>",
    "motif_residues": "<user value; see motif_residues schema>",
    "smiles": "<user value; see smiles schema>",
    "seed": "<user value; see seed schema>"
  }
}
```

For mode-dependent fields, include the fields required by the selected schema branch.

### File checks

```json
{
  "pdb_path": {
    "formats": [
      "pdb"
    ],
    "content_format": "pdb",
    "notes": "Exactly one model; selected chain 2-2000 standard residues, finite N/CA/C coordinates; motif labels present and at least one non-motif residue.",
    "values_by_field": {
```

```json
    "maximum_atoms_including_hydrogens": 128
  }
}
```

### Execution notices

- Live FastAPI requires seed; local runtime and older handoff call it optional. Do not omit until API reconciles.

## Enzyme RFD3

Generate enzyme scaffolds; retain review-only quality rejects separately from passing designs.

[Product description and result interpretation](../enzyme-tools-guide.md#enzyme-rfd3)

Exact job name: `Enzyme_RFD3`.

### Inputs

Fields below belong in `experiment_data`; `experiment_name` is supplied separately.

| Field | Type | Required | Input kind | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `input_path` | string | yes | file | Uploaded .pdb or .cif structure path. |
| `motif_residues` | array | yes | value | Motif labels such as A108. |
| `ligand` | string | yes | value | One or more distinct uppercase component codes, comma-separated; not SMILES. |
| `min_length` | integer | yes | value | Minimum scaffold length. |
| `max_length` | integer | yes | value | Maximum scaffold length; >= min_length. |
| `n_samples` | integer | no / mode-dependent | value | Optional at the connector boundary; request preparation supplies integer 1 only when omitted, before validation and submission. |
| `seed` | integer | no / mode-dependent | value | Optional; 0-4294967295; omit for random seed. |
| `job_name` | string | no / mode-dependent | value | Inner experiment display name. Request preparation copies the confirmed experiment_name here only when omitted; an explicit nonblank label is preserved. Outer routing job_name remains Enzyme_RFD3. |
| `task_name` | string | no / mode-dependent | value | Request preparation supplies rfd3 only when omitted; explicitly invalid values are rejected. This is not the routing job name. |
| `advanced_settings_enabled` | string | no / mode-dependent | value | Wire value is the literal string "true"/"false". Preparation converts JSON booleans and trims/lowercases strings; supplies "false" only when omitted. Explicitly disabling removes documented stale advanced controls, never unsupported fields. |
| `advanced_settings` | object | no / mode-dependent | value | Applied only when advanced_settings_enabled is "true". Preparation omits documented null/blank optional fields and converts documented boolean flags to wire strings. Explicit "false" discards documented stale controls; a missing toggle with nonempty controls is rejected. Unknown fields are never discarded to bypass validation. |

Input kinds: `value` is inline data; `file` requires a platform file reference;
`file_or_value` supports either documented mode; `artifact` is an authorized upstream result reference.
Only local files require a new upload. Never infer input mode from a field name.

```json
      "type": "integer",

      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 512

      "type": "integer",
```

Shape only: replace placeholders with the user's values. This is not a runnable sample.

```json
  "job_name": "Enzyme_RFD3",
  "experiment_name": "<confirmed experiment name>",
  "experiment_data": {
    "input_path": "<user value; see input_path schema>",
    "motif_residues": "<user value; see motif_residues schema>",
    "ligand": "<user value; see ligand schema>",
    "min_length": "<user value; see min_length schema>",
    "max_length": "<user value; see max_length schema>"
  }
}
```

For mode-dependent fields, include the fields required by the selected schema branch.

```json
{
```

```json
    }
  },
  "cross_field": [
    "min_length <= max_length",
    "max_length >= number of motif residues",
    "diffusion_batch_size * n_batches == n_samples when both supplied",
    "contig plus unindexed motifs <= 512 residues",
    "partial_t and num_timesteps must leave at least two noise levels"
  ],

      "right": "max_length"
    }
  ]
}
```

### Execution notices

- Use n_recycle >= 1 if set; zero caused native KeyError X_L.
- A completed job may contain only review-only rejected/ structures and no passing designs/. Inspect manifest.json and rejections.json.
- Runtime IDs/auth are injected by Node; do not put tokenid/user_id/experiment_id in experiment_data.
- The connector prepares a deep copy before preflight and sends that same validated payload. Missing n_samples, task_name and advanced_settings_enabled become 1, rfd3 and string false; missing inner job_name becomes the confirmed experiment_name. Explicitly invalid values are not replaced.
- Documented optional seed/advanced/sampler null or blank placeholders are omitted, including partial_t. Meaningful zeros, string false and selections are preserved. Authorization, upload provenance and partial-validation approval are still required.
- Earlier submissions without a worker-level job_name were accepted and then failed input validation. A reviewed direct-field test completed with an explicit nonempty experiment_data.job_name while outer job_name remained Enzyme_RFD3. Never copy runtime authentication or identity fields.
- Reported NodeAPI HTTP 400 failures required task_name, advanced_settings_enabled and n_samples; blank partial_t caused FastAPI 422 wrapped as NodeAPI 500. Client preparation addresses these reported cases without assuming deployed frontend or backend fixes. Current backend alignment and all advanced configurations remain unverified; contig coverage and partial-diffusion noise-level compatibility still need worker validation.
